name: ReadMD Xiaohongshu viral-mechanism rubric

criteria: title is at most 20 characters including punctuation
formula id is explicit and traceable
at least two tension signals: contrast, number, curiosity, outcome, identity, or time
first paragraph names a concrete task or pain
uses an active decision or removal verb
names the product mechanism without requiring prior context
one primary release feature leads the story
the second captured card is the complete product interface
at most two supporting workflows appear in the body
every claim has source evidence
authentic screenshot statement appears once
release or diff evidence is retained
no exact sentence repeated
no generic AI launch vocabulary
prerelease state disclosed exactly once
all cards are 1080x1440 with one accent system
UI area meets the role minimum
DOM contrast and overflow audits are clean
five clean topics
no external links or banned redirect language in body
prerelease is never described as a formal release

hard_gates: every visual claim has at least one source
no release asset filename appears as a user-facing fix
no exact sentence of eight or more characters repeats
prerelease body discloses preview or update-line status
formal-release wording is forbidden for prereleases
composition design audit has no contrast, small-text, or image failures
